 Justice Chittaranjan Dash
 Order
Order No. 20.01.2023
01. 1.
Heard learned counsel for the Petitioner and the State.

2. This is an application for bail U/s. 438 Cr.P.C. filed by the Petitioner in apprehension of arrest for his alleged involvement in the offences U/s. 420/34 of IPC.
3.

It is submitted by the learned counsel for the Petitioner that due to previous enmity the FIR has been lodged against the present Petitioner and he further submits that he has been falsely implicated in this case.

4. Considering the submission of the learned counsel for the Petitioner, nature of allegations, the circumstances appearing and the seriousness and gravity of the offences, while this Court is not inclined to grant anticipatory bail, it is directed that in the event the Petitioner surrenders and moves for bail in connection with // 2 // Laxmisagar P.S. Case No.448 of 2022 corresponding to C.T. Case No.7880 of 2022 pending in the court of learned J.M.F.C-3., Bhubaneswar within a period of three weeks hence and move for bail, he shall be released on such terms and conditions as would be deemed just and proper by the said court, with further conditions that the Petitioner shall not establish any kind of contract to the present Informant; shall appear in person before the learned court below on each date of posting of the case; shall appear before the I.O. once in a week on such date and time to be fixed by the I.O concerned and shall cooperate with the investigation as and when required till the submission of final form; shall not threaten, intimidate or terrorize the Informant; shall not indulge in any other crime of similar nature to the present case; shall not Soumya Sekhar Behera @ Pintu vs State Of Odisha .... Opp. Party on 20 January, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/89946126/
1 tamper with the prosecution evidence in any manner whatsoever, while on bail.

sentences.text: Violation of any of the conditions shall entail cancellation of bail.
5. It is made clear that the learned court below shall verify the criminal antecedent of the Petitioner.

In case antecedent is noticed, the order of this Court shall not be given effect to and the court shall be free to deal with matter of bail according to its merit without further reference to the present.
6. The ABLAPL is disposed of accordingly.
